evidence.disrupt: 特殊化学/栄養素(コリン・キレート化ミネラル・封入技術)に技術代替の脅威記述なし・蝕ヒット無=settled
evidence.moatdecay: 売上CAGR約7.6-8%で継続複利+のれん減損なし+能動的erosion証拠なし=no(ただし全投下資本ROICが低位=買収premiumの構造は要監視)
evidence.geopol: 米国拠点の特殊化学。主要リスクは国内規制(『regulate EtO or take other actions which could ultimately impact our business』=酸化エチレン規制)で地政学的集中ではない。顧客集中も低い(『In 2025, 2024 and 2023, no customer accounted for more than 10% of total net sales』)=軽微0
evidence.nrr: リカーリング収益指標の開示なし(特殊化学業態)→既定105
evidence.p1: のれん込みROIC5年σ≈1pt(2021-25で約10-12%圏、検死ヘルパー0.6pt)。ニッチ栄養素需要の非景気連動性=<3pt→90
evidence.p2: COVID期の営業利益: 2019年102.6→2020年111.1M(+8.3%)、売上+9%で不況を成長で通過(食品/栄養素=生活必需)。窓内の景気後退はCOVIDのみ(GFCは系列外)のため満点95でなく90
evidence.p3: 検死修正後nde=+0.43(<1)→85。純現金ではなくリボルビング債務164Mを保有(上記kenshi)
evidence.p4: accr=-3.7%(<0=保守)+『Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments None』。誠ヒットの『material weakness』は監査手続の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, and testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness』)であり実指摘ではない→90
evidence.f1: 有形資産上のROIIC(organic)は極めて高い(純PP&E上ROIC53%)が、買収のれん込みの全投下資本での限界リターンはROIC込み約12%=WACC(約9%)+3程度。ロールアップは買収premiumを払い込むため全投下資本の増分リターンは中位→75。減損なし=規律維持で+側
evidence.f2: 特殊栄養素/成分の各ニッチは大きな食品/飼料/医薬TAMの一桁%浸透と推定されるがTAM開示なし。保守側70(注: インフラ的でなく多数の小カテゴリ集合のため概念的当てはめは弱い)
evidence.f3: R&D費 2023:15.0→2024:16.8→2025:18.5M(3年+23%上昇、対売上1.6→1.8%)=明確な+。売上7.6%複利=ニッチでシェア維持/拡大(+、ただし推定)。二符号+寄りだがシェアは推定のため85。顧客集中は低位・悪化なしで-10不適用
evidence.f4: 多segment隣接展開(Human Nutrition & Health / Animal Nutrition & Health / Specialty Products + 植物栄養Metalosate)。各隣接事業が売上5%超で成長、封入技術→栄養→動物健康への横展開=80
evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上: 10-K FY2025(2025-12-31) SEGMENT INFORMATION—Business Segment Net Sales(千$) 総売上 1,037,161 = Human Nutrition and Health 659,387(63.6%) / Animal Nutrition and Health 230,852(22.3%) / Specialty Products 140,976(13.6%) / Other and Unallocated 5,946(0.6%)。セグメント粗利率は HNH 37.0% / ANH 21.9% / SP 54.9% で経済構造が別。SPは13.6%で15%閾値に届かず3本目に数えない。『In 2025, 2024 and 2023, no customer accounted for more than 10% of total net sales』。HNH(ヒト向け choline/K2/MSM・マイクロカプセル、顧客は食品/サプリブランド)と ANH(反芻動物向け保護コリン・キレート、顧客は飼料/酪農・養鶏)は顧客基盤・規制・販路が別立てで隣接が≥15%。(出典: 10-K FY2025 Note—SEGMENT INFORMATION / REVENUE, R20・R21・R80) → 独立した堀は2本と判定＝85
evidence.irr: 70=高摩擦移行困難。10-K Item1 Competition『the winning and retention of customer acceptance of our food and nutrition products involve substantial expenditures for application testing, either internally or at customer/prospect sites, and sales efforts』=顧客側での応用試験を経なければ採用/維持されない(競合が置換するにも同じ試験が要る)。加えて製品は『required to be manufactured in conformity with current Good Manufacturing Practice ("cGMP") regulations as interpreted and enforced by the FDA』で処方への組込みは規制手続を伴う。売上構成はHNH 659.4/ANH 230.9/SP 141.0百万(計1,037.2、HNH=63.6%)でHNHが主。ただし逆向きの自己開示も明確: HNHは『Sales growth for human nutrition applications is reliant on differentiation from lower-cost competitive products through scientific data, intellectual property and customers' appreciation of brand value』、ANHは『Management believes that success in the commodity-oriented choline chloride marketplace is highly dependent on the Company's ability to maintain its strong reputation for excellent product quality and customer service』『The markets for our products are subject to competitive risks because these markets are highly price competitive』。両者を突き合わせると唯一供給(100)・規格ロック(85)には届かず、代替容易(50)でもない=70。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/9326/000000932626000007/bcpc-20251231.htm
evidence.rep: 60=困難。10-K『We currently hold over 130 patents and over 400 registered trademarks in the United States and overseas』『We also use know-how, trade secrets, formulae, and manufacturing techniques』の一方、同じ段落で『we do not believe we are materially dependent on any particular patent or any particular group of patents』『We believe that our sales and competitive position are dependent primarily upon the quality of our products, technical sales efforts and market conditions, rather than on patent protection』と特許依存を自ら否定。競合も『Our competitors include many large and small companies, some of which have greater financial, research and development, production and other resources than us』=資源で勝る相手が実在。資本規模は純有形固定資産306.6百万、SP部門の『five filling facilities, represents a significant capital investment』程度で数十年/$10B級(100)や極困難(80)には届かない。他方 cGMP/EPA許可を要する製造拠点と処方ノウハウがあり数年で追随可(35)でもない=60。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/9326/000000932626000007/bcpc-20251231.htm
evidence.dur: 100=規制/プロセス知型。10-K Intellectual Property『We also use know-how, trade secrets, formulae, and manufacturing techniques that assist in maintaining competitive positions of certain of our products. Formulae and know-how are of particular importance in the manufacture of a number of our proprietary products』=堀の源泉は特許でなく製法ノウハウ(プロセス知)であると自認。規制側も『We produce products which are required to be manufactured in conformity with current Good Manufacturing Practice ("cGMP") regulations as interpreted and enforced by the FDA』、SP部門は酸化エチレン(EtO)取扱いでEPA規制下(『regulate EtO or take other actions which could ultimately impact our business』)、『The Company's performance gases and chemicals are distributed worldwide in specially designed, reusable and recyclable drum and cylinder packaging, to assure compliance with safety, quality and environmental standards as outlined by the applicable regulatory agencies』、農業ミネラルは『The Company has a unique and patented two-step approach』(Metalosate)。ネットワーク効果(85)でもスイッチングコスト単独(75)でもブランド(55)でもなく、規制+プロセス知が第一の型→100。※ANH(売上22.3%)では『reputation for excellent product quality』とブランド寄りの記述もあるが従。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/9326/000000932626000007/bcpc-20251231.htm
